method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the writing-l4-rules skill; the duties with deadlines in cl 17, 18, 8A and 9/9A are regulative rules (PARTY ... MUST/SHANT/DO ... WITHIN ... LEST), three of them run inside plain-fact questions; no REFUSE (gaps answer `not covered` or NOTHING, asserted); every judgment for the carrier or a court asked as an input; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. Second encoding of this Act, beside baseline-2026-10 (untouched). No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Telecommunications Act 1997, the compilation registered as C2026C00224 (Compilation No. 117, compilation date 2026-06-04; Federal Register of Legislation, retrieved 2026-10-13), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A05145.txt. No instrument brought in (none deposited): the Low-impact Facilities Determination, the regulations and the Telecommunications Code of Practice are inputs or out of scope.

checks.command: l4 run ta97-landholder.l4 ; l4 run ta97-cases-landholder.l4
checks.result: 106 assertions satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings; 2 #TRACEs each a BREACH as its expect line says (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. A breached DEONTIC cannot be compared with EQUALS on this l4, so traces are asserted through the module's `the rule ends fulfilled` (CONSIDER ... WHEN FULFILLED) and breaches are #TRACEd.

scope: Schedule 3, from the landholder's seat: cl 2 (definitions used); cl 5, 6, 7 (as the kind of activity); cl 6(5)(b)-(g), 7(3A) (as kinds of temporary facility); cl 8A, 8B, 8C, 9, 9A, 17, 18, 42, 43, 46(7), 47(a), 53; Part 3 cl 62, 63; s 591(1), (2). Out: cl 1, 3, 4; the detail of cl 6 and 7; cl 8, 10-16 (reasonable-steps and instrument-defined conditions); cl 19, 20; Division 6 (cl 21-35, permits); Division 7 (cl 36-39); cl 41, 44, 45, 46(1)-(6), 47(b), 48-52, 54; Part 2 (cl 60, 61); s 591(3) extensions; Schedule 3A; the rest of the Act (Part 19 is in baseline-2026-10).
seat: the landholder: the owner of land a carrier inspects, installs a facility on or maintains a facility on, or an occupier of it other than the owner
